description: Read whether one of your stored experiments can stop: the verdict (stop, keep running, or no winner yet) with its reason and a one-line headline, from a sequential test against control that stays valid however often you look (mSPRT, adjusted for the number of arms), with each arm's chance to beat control and expected loss. Also the traffic split in force now, whether bandit allocation is on with its floors and the weights it would set now, and the weight history: every change the bandit made and every change to its settings. Answers "not enabled" until sequential testing is switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential for the workspace that owns the experiment. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

experiment_key.description: The experiment key, as created (lowercase letters, digits and underscores).

history_limit.description: Most weight history entries to return. Defaults to 50.

name: get_experiment_stopping
